launcher.title: Production
launcher.description: Making things to sell: bills of materials (BOM), costs and runs

productionList.title: Production runs
productionList.subtitle: Runs you have scheduled or completed, with their cost and output.

empty.title: No production runs yet
empty.subtitle: Schedule a production run to consume ingredients and create output.

noMatches.subtitle: Nothing found with these filters. Try widening them.

card.shortage_one: Short of stock: {{count}} ingredient. Completing will be refused.
card.shortage_other: Short of stock: {{count}} ingredients. Completing will be refused.

preview.title: Production preview
preview.subtitle: Cost breakdown and ingredient consumption — no stock changes.
preview.loadFailed: Could not load the cost preview

chart.title: Cost share
chart.empty: No ingredient has a price yet, so there is nothing to chart.

create.title: Record production
create.subtitle: Record what you made, or plan a run. What it takes, what is short and what it costs show beside the form before you save.
create.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU or barcode…

hints.product: Pick an output product to enable preview.
hints.quantity: Enter a planned quantity greater than zero to enable preview.
hints.storage: Select a target location to enable preview.

errors.missingFields: Pick a product, qty and location first.

create.batchHintMade: One batch of the BOM makes {{batch}}. Enter what came out, not the number of batches.
create.batchHintPlanned: One batch of the BOM makes {{batch}}. Enter how much to make, not the number of batches.
create.submitNeedsIngredients: Add ingredients to the BOM first

needs.pick: Pick a product, how much and where it goes to see what the run takes.
needs.unknown: {{have}} in stock, in a unit the BOM cannot be compared with
needs.marginLeft: You sell at {{price}}, which leaves {{result}} on each {{unit}} you make.
needs.marginLost: You sell at {{price}}, which is {{result}} per {{unit}} below cost.
needs.savingsLeft: In a shop it costs {{price}}; each {{unit}} you make saves {{result}}.
needs.savingsLost: In a shop it costs {{price}}, {{result}} per {{unit}} less than making it.
needs.unmeasurable: An ingredient's unit cannot be compared with its stock, so the run cannot say what to take. Fix the BOM line's unit first.
needs.shortMade: It is already made, so the goods were there — the stock records hold too little. The run is saved, and the short ingredients are put up for a count.
needs.shortPlanned: This run is short of some ingredients. You can plan it now and buy what is missing.
needs.addOne: Add {{quantity}} of {{name}} to the shopping list
needs.addAll: Add what is missing to the shopping list
needs.addFailed: Could not add to the shopping list

createRecipe.title: New BOM
createRecipe.subtitle: Pick the output product and give the BOM a name.
createRecipe.batchYieldHint: How much one batch makes, counted in the product's unit. Leave it empty for 1.
createRecipe.unitFirst: Pick the unit next to the quantity first.

detail.title: Production order
detail.subtitle: Review ingredients, costs and run state.
detail.cancelNeedsManager: Cancelling a production run is a manager's call — ask someone who can manage production.

completeConfirm.title: Complete production run?
completeConfirm.description: This consumes the listed ingredients and produces the output. While nothing it made has been used, Undo run takes it back.
completeConfirm.actualQtyHint: Leave empty to use planned quantity. Enter less for scrap, more for overproduction. Ingredients are consumed as planned regardless of the actual quantity.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel production run?
cancelConfirm.description: Cancelling marks this draft as cancelled. No stock will be moved.

reverseConfirm.title: Undo this production run?
reverseConfirm.description: The ingredients go back to the locations and batches they were taken from, and what the run made leaves its location. The run stays on record, marked as undone.

card.totalCostUndone: Cost before the run was undone
card.totalCostGap_one: {{count}} ingredient was drawn from stock with no cost, so it is missing from this total: {{names}}. The preview before saving can show a higher figure, because it may estimate a missing cost from other stock or supplier offers.
card.totalCostGap_other: {{count}} ingredients were drawn from stock with no cost, so they are missing from this total: {{names}}. The preview before saving can show a higher figure, because it may estimate a missing cost from other stock or supplier offers.

detail.emptyLines: No ingredients were recorded for this run.
detail.plannedIngredientsHint: What this run will take. Nothing has left stock yet. Quantities are read from the BOM when the run closes, so BOM edits change an open draft.
detail.emptyLinesPlanned: This run would consume nothing — its BOM lists no ingredients.

line.unmeasurableShort: short — units cannot be compared with stock
line.shortfall: {{quantity}} not in the records — due a count

detail.setDefaultFailed: Could not set the default BOM

cost.emptyLines: Nothing to price yet — add ingredients on the Composition tab.

history.title: Production history
history.empty: No production runs for this BOM yet.

detail.emptyBom: This BOM lists no ingredients — the run would create output out of nothing. Add ingredients first.
detail.noBom: This product has no BOM — the run would create output out of nothing. Create a BOM first.
detail.reverseNeedsManager: Undoing a production run is a manager's call — ask someone who can manage production.
detail.reverseFailed: Could not undo the production run
detail.processStepsAddPlaceholder: Describe the step — Enter starts a new line, Ctrl+Enter adds it

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this BOM?
deleteConfirm.description: Its ingredients and process steps go with it. Production runs already recorded are kept.

detail.plannedShortageHint_one: Planned consumption exceeds stock — {{count}} ingredient short. Completing this production will be refused.
detail.plannedShortageHint_other: Planned consumption exceeds stock — {{count}} ingredients short. Completing this production will be refused.

bom.yieldHint: A planning figure: how much extra to reserve so the plan adds up. Leaving it at 0 is normal — what was really lost is measured when the order is closed, by entering the quantity that actually came out.
bom.treeHint: The only view that shows one BOM nested inside another, and the only place a line can be re-parented. Worth opening once an ingredient has a BOM of its own.
bom.unitMustBeConvertible: Only units that can be read as {{unit}} are offered — a line the maker cannot convert is refused.

composition.batchYieldEdit: Change how much this BOM makes
composition.batchYieldHint: How much one batch of this BOM makes. Unit cost = batch cost ÷ this number.
composition.emptyLines: No ingredients yet — add the first one below.
composition.introduction: A BOM is the list of what goes into one batch of this product. The costs on the Cost & result tab are added up from it, and stock is issued against it when a production order is closed.

errors.duplicateIngredient: This BOM already lists that ingredient.
errors.yieldInvalid: How much the BOM makes must be greater than zero.

tree.title: Multi-level BOM
tree.hint: Drag a row onto another to nest it.
tree.empty: No ingredients yet. Add them in the ingredients section above; they appear here as soon as there is something to nest.

pricing.title: Sale price calculator
pricing.subtitle: Gross-margin model — slide the margin to preview the suggested sale price.
pricing.saveFailed: Failed to save the default margin

catalog.title: Bills of materials
catalog.subtitle: Making things to sell: every BOM with its costs, margins and stock
catalog.unitCostIncomplete_one: 1 ingredient in the last run had no purchase cost recorded.
catalog.unitCostIncomplete_other: {{count}} ingredients in the last run had no purchase cost recorded.

empty.title: No BOMs yet
empty.subtitle: Create your first BOM to start tracking production costs.

noMatches.title: No BOM matches
noMatches.subtitle: Nothing found for "{{query}}". Try a shorter phrase.

catalog.estimateCostIncomplete_one: 1 ingredient in this estimate has no purchase cost recorded.
catalog.estimateCostIncomplete_other: {{count}} ingredients in this estimate have no purchase cost recorded.

settings.title: Production settings
settings.referenceDirection: What the result is measured against
settings.referenceDirectionHint: Margin if you sell what you make; savings if you make it instead of buying it. The reference price on each BOM is then your sale price or the shop price.
settings.allowOverproductionHint: When on, closing an order may record more than was planned.
settings.availabilityCheckScopeHint: Global counts stock across all locations; per location checks each location on its own.
settings.createOnShortageStrategyHint: What happens when an order is created without enough ingredients: allow it, warn, or block it.
settings.subtitle: What the result means, and how production treats shortages.
settings.whereReferenceDirection: The result is named this way on BOM cards, production orders and the monthly summary.
settings.immediateNote: Each choice saves as you make it. There is no undo — set it back the same way.
settings.advancedHint: Rules for shortages and overproduction. The defaults suit a small workshop.

availability.blockedHint: Restock these ingredients or switch the shortage strategy in settings.
availability.warnHint: You can still create the draft — availability will be re-checked at completion.
availability.completeShortageHint: These ingredients ran out since the draft was created.
availability.completeShortageHintNever: These ingredients were never enough for this run — it was created over stock.

widget.title: {{result}} by month
widget.hintSource: Set in the Production module's settings
widget.empty: No completed runs with a result yet.

permissions.readDesc: Can browse BOMs, costs and production orders
permissions.writeDesc: Can create production orders and close runs — this moves stock
permissions.manageDesc: Can edit BOMs, process steps and module settings, and cancel runs — a BOM decides what production takes from stock

costSource.none: no cost recorded for this stock

gap.partial_one: 1 ingredient has no rate, so it is missing from this figure.
gap.partial_other: {{count}} ingredients have no rate, so they are missing from this figure.
gap.none_one: No rate for the only ingredient — there is nothing to add up.
gap.none_other: No rate for any of the {{count}} ingredients — there is nothing to add up.

margin.label: Margin
margin.definition: Sale price minus the cost to make it

savings.label: Savings vs shop price
savings.definition: Shop price minus the cost to make it
